textRuns.value: Centroid Coordinates: Official USGS GNIS / US Census Bureau 2020 Municipal Centers & UGA Centroids. 'Unincorporated Skagit County' (53,380) includes the Bay View Ridge and Swinomish UGAs; the county's Rural allocation excludes them. Basis pending SCOG confirmation. Official countywide population is 134,600 (OFM April 1, 2025 determination).
